description: This file contains utility functions for generating curl commands and fetch calls based on network request data, including platform-specific escaping functions and handling of request headers and body data.

methods.name: generateCurlCommand
methods.description: Generates a curl command string from a network resource entry, with platform-specific escaping and header handling.

methods.name: generateFetchCall
methods.description: Generates a fetch API call string from a network resource entry, supporting different styles (browser or Node.js).
